summary: We are looking for a Data Engineer who can design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines and infrastructure to support analytics, reporting, and machine learning initiatives.
responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows
Collect, integrate, and transform structured and unstructured data from multiple sources
Develop and manage data warehouses, data lakes, and data models
Ensure data reliability, quality, security, and performance
required_skills: Strong proficiency in Python and/or SQL for data engineering tasks
Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and data workflows
Hands-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases
Strong understanding of data modeling, schema design, and data warehousing concepts
nice_to_have_skills: Experience with big data tools (Spark, Hadoop, Kafka)
Exposure to real-time or streaming data pipelines
Knowledge of data lake frameworks (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi)
benefits: Opportunity to work on global, data-intensive projects
